authority.note: This packet frames required adversarial reviews; script generation never answers or decides them.

limitations: Evidence context is assembled mechanically and may include irrelevant rows; the reviewer must judge relevance.
A pending red-team prompt is not a judgment_review and cannot support an M6 decision.
No script-authored verdict or recommendation is permitted.
Priority weights allocate review attention only.
Later judgment must preserve Commander-first identity and bracket-specific context.

reviews.adversarial_challenge: Assume multiple permanent types are answered over several turns. Identify which strategic routes actually rebuild and which collapse after repeated removal.

value: No generic combo packages added just to raise the theoretical ceiling (decisions L17).
Prefer Curses that are good to recycle over narrow ones (decisions swaps).

blueprint_failure_modes.description: Enchantment wipes remove the whole Curse board at once.
mitigations: Lynde returns Curses that hit the graveyard

blueprint_failure_modes.description: Curses parked on you hurt you.
No compact win: a slow damage clock gives opponents time.

value.interaction: Mana Drain, Fierce Guardianship, Swan Song, Deadly Rollick, Toxic Deluge, Damnation, Cyclonic Rift.
value.mana: 35 lands, Sol Ring, Ancient Tomb, Signets and Talismans.
value.protection: Deathtouch, Propaganda, Deflecting Swat, attack-tax Curses.

accepted_role.advances_plan: Lynde is the Curse recursion and the draw-two engine; the reset outlets only exist to feed her.
accepted_role.honest_note: There is no compact win: Commander Spellbook finds no combos in the list, so the deck wins slowly through stacked Curse damage. Returned Curses also hit you until Lynde moves them (M1 lynde-06).
